baseline.source: The 32 blocking records in final-audit-report.json at commit 1a85327, produced by Audit recursive coverage and issue the final dossier disposition.

disposition_definitions.resolved_by_evidence: The missing observable fact was captured with privacy-safe evidence.
disposition_definitions.downgraded_nonblocking: Recorded stakeholder authority removed exact reference behavior from the implementation-readiness contract and prohibited an unsupported parity claim.
disposition_definitions.approved_substitute: Recorded stakeholder authority selected an independently licensed or platform-owned Zenbu boundary and prohibited exact-reference equivalence.
disposition_definitions.excluded_from_mvp: Recorded stakeholder authority moved the complete content family beyond the MVP destination.
